intro.title: Partnership built on trust and innovation
intro.description_1: We are more than a photovoltaic power plant installation company. We are driven by a clear vision, deep expertise, and a genuine commitment to accelerating the transition toward a greener and more sustainable future.
intro.description_2: Our journey began with two people united not only by a shared personal path, but also by a strong belief that renewable energy has the power to change the world. Over the years, this belief has evolved into a solid business built on extensive hands-on experience in the photovoltaic sector. Through working on diverse projects, we have gained a comprehensive understanding of the full installation process, as well as the technical and organizational challenges that may arise on site.
more_paragraphs: VS CONSTRUCTION SERVICES Ltd. is a family-owned construction company founded on the principles of transparency, integrity, and long-term partnership. We believe that trust, professionalism, and clear communication are essential to delivering successful projects.

Our team consists of highly qualified professionals with expertise in construction, project management, policy compliance, and structured project execution. With a proven installation track record across three continents, we bring international experience, strong operational capacity, and a results-oriented approach to every project we undertake.

By combining in-depth industry knowledge with disciplined execution and a hands-on mindset, we deliver high-quality, reliable solar energy solutions tailored to our clients’ needs. Our dynamic project portfolio and flexible resource management have consistently demonstrated our ability to meet deadlines, adapt to complex environments, and deliver outstanding results.

VS CONSTRUCTION SERVICES Ltd. provides full EPC services in Bulgaria and turnkey photovoltaic installation services across Europe, supporting our partners throughout every phase of the project lifecycle — from planning to successful commissioning.

trust.title: Trust & Transparency
trust.description: We build long-term partnerships through full transparency, clear communication, and accountable project execution. Our clients rely on us for honest processes, predictable results, and a shared commitment to success at every stage of the project.

innovation.title: Innovation in Technology & Professionalism
innovation.description: We utilize proprietary software for photovoltaic project management, enabling accurate work tracking, real-time reporting, and comprehensive site documentation. Combined with professional execution and structured processes, this ensures full control, transparency, and high-quality delivery throughout the entire project lifecycle.

values.title: Innovations in Technology and Ecological Solutions
values.description: Our values define how we work, how we build partnerships, and how we deliver results. They are the foundation of our decision-making, our on-site execution, and our long-term relationships with clients and partners. Guided by integrity, responsibility, and continuous improvement, we are committed to delivering reliable, high-quality photovoltaic solutions with consistency and professionalism.

team_work.title: Teamwork
team_work.description: We foster a strong team culture built on dedication, professionalism, and shared responsibility. By combining experience, diversity, and collaboration at both management and operational levels, we achieve consistent and efficient project execution.

safety.title: Safety & Reliability
safety.description: Safety is a core priority in all our operations. We work in strict compliance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations, ensuring reliable execution and secure working conditions on every project site.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: We build long-term partnerships based on fairness, transparency, and accountability. Clear communication and ethical conduct are fundamental to earning and maintaining the trust of our clients and partners.

respect.title: Respect
respect.description: We value respect as the foundation of every professional relationship. By recognizing expertise, experience, and individual contribution, we create a constructive and respectful environment for our employees and clients.

support.title: Support
support.description: We support our clients through efficient project coordination and optimized workflows. By delivering cost-effective and well-structured photovoltaic solutions, we add value at every stage of the installation process.

flexibility.title: Flexibility
flexibility.description: We adapt quickly to project requirements and on-site conditions. Our flexibility allows us to provide reliable support whenever and wherever our clients need us.

team.title: Our Team of Experts
team.description: Our team consists of highly qualified and certified professionals with extensive experience in photovoltaic construction and project execution. From project management and site supervision to installation and quality control, each team member plays a key role in delivering safe, efficient, and high-performing solar power plants. With international on-site experience across multiple European markets, our teams are accustomed to working in complex environments, strict regulatory frameworks, and demanding project timelines. We operate with a strong focus on safety, coordination, and technical precision. By combining hands-on expertise, structured processes, and modern project management tools, we ensure reliable execution, transparent reporting, and consistent quality on every project we deliver.

members.name: Stefan Ormanliev
members.description: Stefan is a co-founder of VS Construction Services with over eight years of hands-on experience in the photovoltaic industry. Throughout his career, he has specialized in on-site execution, actively participating in the installation of photovoltaic projects across three continents. With a strong belief that diversity and continuous improvement are key drivers of success, Stefan promotes a culture of collaboration, responsibility, and high performance within the company. His approach is based on a detailed understanding of every phase of the construction process and a constant focus on identifying the most efficient and practical solutions. For Stefan, the success of each project depends on precision in execution, strong coordination, and true synergy among all members of the team.

members.name: Vesela Ormanlieva
members.description: Vesela is a legal professional by education and an entrepreneur by vocation, with over twelve years of experience in the photovoltaic industry. Throughout her career, she has faced and navigated complex regulatory, operational, and market challenges, successfully transforming obstacles into opportunities for growth and innovation. Driven by a strong belief in the transition toward a cleaner and more sustainable world powered by renewable energy, Vesela plays a key role in shaping the strategic direction of the company. What motivates her most is seeing ideas turn into reality and challenges evolve into measurable achievements. Her leadership approach is centered on recognizing individual strengths, building strong teams, and creating an environment where people can perform at their best and deliver outstanding results.
